title: Meta reconsiders 2030 net-zero goal amid record emissions from AI data centers
summary: Meta is “re-evaluating” 2030 sustainability goals. Will others follow?
llm_summary: Meta has announced that it is “re‑evaluating” its 2030 net‑zero emissions target after its AI‑driven data centers set new records for power use and carbon output.
